items.title: Meaning of 'unlikely'
items.explanation: 'Unlikely' means something that is not likely to happen. In the story, Gajaraj was sad because he had no friends, which made his situation unlikely.

items.title: Gajaraj's feelings
items.explanation: Gajaraj felt sad when he did not have a friend and happy when he met Buntee, as Buntee became his best friend.

items.title: The mahout's role
items.explanation: The mahout was a kind man who served Gajaraj food and gave him a bath in the elephant pond daily, acting as a caretaker but not a true friend.

items.title: Gajaraj's reaction to Buntee
items.explanation: When Gajaraj met Buntee, he was filled with joy because Buntee became his unlikely best friend.
